channel.title: Kryptokompis - guides and news
channel.description: Step by step for each exchange, how to report crypto in the Norwegian tax return, and news from Kryptokompis. A new article every other week.

item.title: Revolut X: import the account statement
item.description: The Revolut X API does not show transfers or fees, so the account statement is the source. How to get it.

item.title: Other exchanges and wallets: the import template
item.description: Nordnet, NBX, hardware wallets and anything else without its own import - fill in the template and import it.

item.title: KuCoin: API key and older history
item.description: KuCoin's API only reaches the last 12 months. How to connect, and how to add older years.

item.title: Kryptokompis 0.5: a new name and a portfolio that updates itself
item.description: The app is now called Kryptokompis. The portfolio shows every coin from every exchange in NOK, with the 24-hour change.

item.title: Kraken: connect with an API key
item.description: Create a read-only key on Kraken, plus a separate Kraken Futures key if you trade futures. Takes five minutes.

item.title: How to report crypto in the Norwegian tax return
item.description: Where the figures go, why gains and losses are entered separately, and what to do with cash on exchanges.

item.title: Firi: import your transactions
item.description: Download the transactions file from Firi and import it. Trades, staking and fees are included.

item.title: Coinbase: API key or statement file
item.description: Connect Coinbase with a View-only key (ECDSA), or import the transaction history as CSV.

item.title: Binance: connect with an API key
item.description: Create a read-only Binance key and paste it into Kryptokompis.
